state.revoked: This pairing was revoked on the Host. Remove it and pair again to reconnect.
state.replaced: This Host is now controlled from another browser. Reconnect to take over again.
state.locked: The Host is locked. Unlock it on the Host to continue.
state.expired: This pairing has expired. Pair the Host again to continue.

linkError.REMOTE_LINK_DOWN: The connection to the Host is down. This tab will keep retrying.
linkError.REMOTE_UPSTREAM_AUTH: The Host did not accept this request. Check the pairing on the Host.
linkError.REMOTE_QUOTA: This tab is sending too many requests to the Host. Wait a moment.
linkError.REMOTE_TOO_LARGE: That request is too large to send to the Host.
linkError.REMOTE_PROTOCOL: The Host runs an incompatible version. Update it to continue.
linkError.REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED_MODE: Remote work is not supported in this server mode.
linkError.generic: There was a problem reaching the Host.

target.sessionExpiredBody: This tab lost its session with the Host. It will resume by itself once the Controller page renews it; if it does not, reload the tab.

settings.title: Remote work
settings.description: Control this machine from another browser, or control other machines from here, through an end-to-end encrypted relay. The relay only forwards encrypted data.
settings.unavailable: Remote work is not available on this server.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the Remote work settings. Retrying automatically.

relay.title: Relay
relay.description: Both machines connect out to the same relay. Enter its address and the shared secret once; the secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
relay.secretStored: A secret is stored. Enter it again to save a change.
relay.secretTooShort: The relay secret must be at least 32 characters. Paste the full secret that was set on the relay.
relay.invalidUrl: Enter a valid relay address starting with wss:// (or https://).
relay.changeWarning: Changing the relay revokes every pairing. All Controllers and Hosts must pair again.
relay.failed: The relay settings could not be saved.
relay.reauthDescription: Enter your account password to save the relay settings.

accept.title: Accept Controllers
accept.description: While this is on, paired Controllers can connect to this machine and run Claude Code on it. Turn it off when you do not need it.
accept.reauthDescription: Enter your account password to change this setting.
accept.failed: The setting could not be changed.
accept.unsupported: Remote work cannot be turned on in this server mode.

warnings.masterKeyFile: The master key was generated into a file on this machine. Set CLOUDCLI_REMOTE_MASTER_KEY so pairing secrets are encrypted with a key kept outside the data directory.
warnings.masterKeyMismatch: The master key changed or is missing. Remote work is turned off and existing pairings cannot be read. Restore the original key; a new one is never generated while pairings exist.
warnings.approvalTimeout: Tool approvals on this Host time out after {{duration}}. If you answer from a Controller, set CLAUDE_TOOL_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 (5 minutes) so requests do not expire first. This also applies to Local use of this Host.
warnings.unsupportedMode: Remote work is not supported in this server mode (platform mode, or API_KEY set on a Controller).

device.unverifiedHint: The Controller chose this name itself. It is not verified.

controllers.title: Paired Controllers
controllers.description: Controllers paired with this Host. Disconnect closes a connection now; Revoke deletes the pairing for good.
controllers.empty: No Controllers are paired with this Host.
controllers.suspendedReason: This Controller sent too many refused requests. It can reconnect when the time is up; Revoke ends the pairing for good.
controllers.revokeDescription: Enter your account password to revoke the pairing with {{name}}. It cannot be undone.
controllers.revokedUnconfirmed: Pairing with {{name}} was revoked on this machine, but the relay has not confirmed it yet. The relay keeps being asked until it does.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: A best-effort record of what Controllers did on this Host, newest first. A Controller owns a terminal on this machine and could alter the audit database, so treat this as evidence, not proof. Names are chosen by the Controller and are not verified.
audit.loadFailed: The audit log could not be loaded.

changed.command: Command changed by the Controller before it was approved. It now reads:
changed.path: Path changed by the Controller before it was approved. It now reads:
changed.url: URL changed by the Controller before it was approved. It now reads:

pairHost.startDescription: Enter your account password to create a pairing code.
pairHost.lockedUntil: Pairing is locked until {{time}} after too many wrong verification codes.
pairHost.title: Pair a Controller
pairHost.codeHelp: On the Controller, open Settings > Remote work > Pair with a Host and type this code.
pairHost.expired: The code has expired. Close this window and start again.
pairHost.waiting: Waiting for the Controller to enter the code…
pairHost.sasLabel: Verification code shown on the Controller
pairHost.sasHelp: Type the 6 digits the Controller displays. They must match, otherwise someone else may be on the line.
pairHost.locked: Too many wrong codes. Pairing was cancelled and is locked for 15 minutes (until {{time}}).
pairHost.failed: Pairing failed. Close this window and start again.
pairHost.confirmFailed: The code could not be checked. Try again.
pairHost.done: Paired. The Controller can now connect while Accept is on.

pairController.title: Pair with a Host
pairController.codeHelp: Open Settings > Remote work on the Host, choose Pair a Controller, and type the code it shows.
pairController.deviceNameHelp: Shown on the Host, up to 32 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
pairController.sasHelp: Type this code on the Host to finish pairing. Do not continue if the Host asks for something else.
pairController.waitingHost: Waiting for the Host to confirm…
pairController.done: Paired. The Host now appears in the list and as a tab.

failure.expired: This pairing code has expired. Ask the Host for a new one.
failure.wrongCode: That pairing code was not recognised. Check it and try again.
failure.full: The Host already has the maximum number of pairings.
failure.rejected: The Host did not accept the verification code. Start again with a new code.
failure.generic: Pairing failed. Try again with a new code.

peers.title: Paired Hosts
peers.description: Machines this browser can control. Each one opens as its own tab.
peers.renameHint: Shown on its tab instead of the device name. Stays on this browser's server; leave it empty to use the device name again.
peers.renameFailed: The name could not be saved.
peers.forgetConfirm: Forget {{name}}? This browser stops controlling it; revoke the pairing on the Host as well.
peers.forgetFailed: The pairing could not be removed.

reauth.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
